quotes.text: Bug 1895923 added a browser_parsable_css.js ignore entry for a new upstream html.css content parse message. It matches the source name, the specific parser error, and isFromDevTools:false. This keeps the static test from suppressing unrelated CSS errors or DevTools messages. D209935 asked to run the test file and accepted the port; no local test was run in this history study. The current checkout has since changed this test path, so use this as a scoped historical test-maintenance pattern.
